user.title: Connect to RailFeed
user.description: Create a free API key on your RailFeed account's API Keys page (railfeed.co.uk/api-keys), then enter the three-letter station code (CRS), e.g. BVD for Belvedere or KGX for London King's Cross.

data_description.calling_at: Three-letter CRS code of a station on the train's route, e.g. ABW. Only trains that stop there after this station are listed, whether or not it is their final destination. Add the same station again with a different code to track several destinations.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate RailFeed
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {station} was rejected. Enter a new key from railfeed.co.uk/api-keys.

error.invalid_station: RailFeed doesn't recognise that station code. Use the three-letter CRS code.
error.invalid_calling_at: Enter a single three-letter CRS code that RailFeed knows, different from the station above.
error.rate_limited: RailFeed rate limit reached. Try again in a minute.

abort.already_configured: That station is already set up with that destination.

data.calling_at: Only trains calling at this station

data_description.scan_interval: Minimum 30. RailFeed's feeds don't update faster than that.
data_description.max_departures: How many upcoming departures to include in the 'departures' attribute.
data_description.passenger_only: Hides freight, empty stock and charters.
data_description.calling_at: Optional. Three-letter CRS code of a station on the train's route, e.g. ABW. Only trains that stop there after this station are listed, whether or not it is their final destination. Leave blank for all.
data_description.via: Optional. Comma-separated CRS codes of stations that tell routes apart, e.g. GNW, LEW (up to 5). Trains calling at one of them get the word 'via' and the station name added to their destination, e.g. London Cannon Street via Greenwich. Leave blank for none.
data_description.destinations: Optional. Comma-separated CRS codes of the train's final destination, e.g. KGX, EDB. Leave blank for all.

error.invalid_destinations: Use comma-separated three-letter CRS codes, e.g. KGX, EDB.
error.invalid_calling_at: Enter a single three-letter CRS code that RailFeed knows, different from this station.
error.invalid_via: Use up to 5 comma-separated three-letter CRS codes that RailFeed knows, none of them this station or the 'calling at' station.
error.rate_limited: RailFeed rate limit reached. Try again in a minute.
